documents.content: HTTP 200 on an order read means the request succeeded, not that the order completed. Callback is emitted only after COMPLETED. A PROCESSING order does not prove a callback failure. Query current order state before drawing a root cause.
documents.query: async order callback 200 vs 202 contract semantics
documents.title: Order lifecycle and callback trigger

result.reason: 确认订单 GET 200 与回调 202 的契约语义，避免把未到期的回调误判为故障。
Delivery is ACKNOWLEDGED with receiver 202; need method to correlate transport ACK vs receiver processing before concluding fault.

skill.content: Check the bound callback delivery record, correlate order version and event ID. FAILED/503 suggests a delivery failure. ACKNOWLEDGED/202 requires receiver processing verification for the same event. QUEUED does not mean processed. Use query retrieval for the current integration contract if uncertain. Never resend or modify permissions.
